# Fully pinned dependency set, resolved for Python 3.12.

# matplotlib, seaborn, pytest) is pinned to the versions the test suite runs
# against; everything else is resolved around them.

#   numpy pandas matplotlib seaborn scipy statsmodels patsy scikit-learn pytest
#   shiny plotly==5.24 kaleido ipywidgets shinywidgets anywidget
#   py4cytoscape>=1.12.0 requests>=2.25.0 matplotlib-venn mcp<2
#
# To regenerate, write those into a file and run:
#   uv pip compile <file> --python-version 3.12 --python-platform linux --no-header --output-file requirements.txt
#
# patsy is imported directly by Scripts/refactored_aft.py; it is listed as a
# direct dependency rather than relied on as a statsmodels transitive.
